title: fix(app-shell): a flow that dropped a read-only field warns the person who clicked, naming the field by its label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4WAazfD26yZrjang7sPJov)_

Fixes #33009
Fixes #32861

Clause-②: yes (widening: the parser is exported from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s entry; an i18n key, if added, widens too; the dev measures and reports)
Metadata-protocol: none

Measured: the widening is three new exports of `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (`isWireDroppedFieldsEntry`, `asDroppedFieldsNotice`, type `WireDroppedFieldsEntry`), unchanged in body; no i18n key is added (the existing `detail.writeStripped*` wording is reused).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台读流程回答里的 `droppedFields`。员工从记录按钮启动流程（列表/页面和记录页两处），或在流程屏幕点「提交」继续，若流程的写入步骤丢掉了只读字段，会弹出黄色警告，用字段的中文名说明哪个字段没写进去。
- 为什么改：#32666 的「提交审批」场景：流程写只读的「状态」，写入被丢掉，按钮却答成功，记录仍是「草稿」，员工什么也看不到。服务端 #33007 已在回答里带上被丢字段，这里让控制台显示出来。
- 风险与回滚：只加提示，不改流程结果、不改刷新和成功提示；回答里没有该字段（干净运行或旧服务端）时与以前完全一样；失败的运行不加这条提示。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowLaunch.ts`（新读取器 `announceFlowDroppedFields` 及 `settled` 里的调用）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx`（继续运行时的调用）、`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`（只加 export）。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.flowDroppedFields-33009.test.tsx`，应见 5 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，契约复审由分诊席做，席位落地。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: the existing `droppedFields` wire gate and parser (`isWireDroppedFieldsEntry`, `asDroppedFieldsNotice`, with its skew arm for an unknown `reason`) and their shared `WireDroppedFieldsEntry` type are exported. Bodies unchanged; no second copy anywhere.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `utils/flowLaunch.ts`: one reader, `announceFlowDroppedFields(json, { t, fieldLabel, dataSource })`, parses `data.droppedFields` with that parser and speaks it through the existing `writeWarningToast.emitWriteWarning` (the record save's own title, per-reason sentence and label lookup), one event per object the entries name. `launchConsoleFlow` calls it in `settled()` for both doors (action door and trigger route), so both launch hosts (`useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`) are covered by one call; it is skipped on a failed launch. Not awaited, so the label lookup never holds the click's outcome or its refresh.
- `views/FlowRunner.tsx`: the resume answer goes through the same reader (every non-failed answer).
- Hosts: `useConsoleActionRuntime` and `RecordDetailView` pass `{ t, fieldLabel, dataSource }` into `launchConsoleFlow`.
- Wording: the existing `detail.writeStrippedTitle` / `detail.writeStripped*` keys; no new key.

**Label source chosen (the order asked which):** the host's `dataSource`. In the console it IS the `ObjectStackAdapter` (`AppContent` / `ConsoleShell`: `const dataSource = useAdapter()`), every host already holds it (it renders their forms; `FlowRunner` already takes it as a prop), and its cached `getObjectSchema` is exactly what `AdapterProvider` hands the save toast. So no host gains a dependency, and the flow toast labels fields by the same path the save toast does. A data source without `getObjectSchema` names fields by api name. Alternatives measured and not taken: building a schema source from the hosts' `objects` (would miss an object the flow writes that is not in the loaded list, and would be a second label path); `useAdapter()` inside each host (a new hook call in three places for a value they already hold).

**Per object, not per click:** a flow can write any object, so each entry is labelled on the object it names; an off-spec entry with no `object` is named by api name rather than guessed onto the clicked record's object (where `status` would get the wrong object's label).

## Tests

New, all against the real runtime (real `ActionRunner`, flow handler, launch module, reader, `writeWarningToast`, `FlowRunner`, en pack; only the network, router, toaster and `getObjectSchema` stubbed):

- `hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.flowDroppedFields-33009.test.tsx` (5): the #32666 shape through the action door → one warning `Saved — but some fields did not take effect` / `Read-only, so it did not take effect: Approval status`; a clean click → none; the trigger route → the same warning; the resume path (paused, then Submit answered with the drop) → the warning; CONTROL: a resume answer without `droppedFields` closes with `Flow "Submit" completed` and no warning.
- `views/RecordDetailView.flowDroppedFields-33009.test.tsx` (2): the #32666 shape on the record page → the warning naming `Approval status`; CONTROL: a clean click → none.
- `utils/__tests__/flowLaunch.droppedFields-33009.test.ts` (8): parse through data-objectstack's parser incl. skew arm and a no-string `fields` entry dropped; per-object labelling across two objects; unknown reason → `Not applied by the server: …`; no `object` → api name, no schema lookup; data source without `getObjectSchema` → api name; CONTROL: no member → no toast; a failed launch carrying the member → no warning.
- `utils/__tests__/flowLaunch.translation-12075.test.tsx`: passes the new required input.

<details><summary>Ablation (fix commented out, red, restored by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`)</summary>

- A: `flowLaunch.ts` `settled()` call removed → 3 failed (record page #32666 shape, runtime #32666 shape, trigger route); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- B: `FlowRunner.tsx` resume call removed → 1 failed (the resume path); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- C: the failed-launch guard removed → 1 failed (failed answer gets no "saved, but" warning); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

ui tests import `@object-ui/*` source, so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and run.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Card item 4 (out of scope, `domain:server`): the resume reader reads whatever the resume answer carries; a `subflow` child that paused and resumed, and a `map` item's run, do not roll their drops up to the parent answer yet. Tracked by #33019; the console reads a present member as a drop and never claims "nothing was dropped", so no console change is owed when #33019 lands.
- Browser check: NOT MEASURED. The #32666 shape is a runtime-authored flow (no shipped example has a record-action flow writing a readonly field), so a browser run needs the whole-tree build plus authoring an object, a flow and an action at runtime; the pins above drive the real console runtime with only the network stubbed.

## Verification

All local runs on head `ab4b0720` (`origin/main` `c54a23d2` merged; main had not moved since the branch point).

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 38 families; all 38 ran, exit 0 each; `--ran` reconciliation: "38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 38 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (exit 0) and `pnpm check:test-source-alias` (exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check` :: exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (src + `tsconfig.test.json`) :: exit 0.
- `vitest run packages/data-objectstack/` :: 119 files, 1376 tests passed.
- `vitest run` app-shell `utils/`, `hooks/`, `providers/`, `views/__tests__/FlowRunner*`, `views/RecordDetailView.flow*`, `views/RecordDetailView.apiFlowRefusal*`, `flow-envelope.ratchet.test.ts` :: 217 files passed, 1 skipped; 2276 tests passed, 8 skipped. The rest of `views/` (does not finish on the shared box) is declared to CI.
- Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full farm: CI.
